scares.description: Mary closes the fridge door to reveal Max standing behind it.
Henry puts his hand over Zoey’s mouth.
James bumps into something while searching the house.
There is some loud banging on the door.
James briefly glimpses the outline of someone.
Zoey’s face pops up in front of the camera on Max’s remote controlled car.
James sees the stranger holding a gun to Zoey’s head.
A member of the masked gang appears in front of Max.
Another purger bursts through a window and attacks James.
The gang leader appears and stabs James.
A purger appears in a doorway and screams at Mary.
